name: Metalmorphose Ironworks
description: Custom wrought iron with a French twist. Eric Zandotti, master blacksmith, Chester County studio near the Brandywine River. Call (484) 919-4548.

hero.headline: Bienvenue. Custom iron with a French twist
hero.sub: Eric Zandotti is a master blacksmith. The Chester County studio sits near the Brandywine River. Wrought iron is in the family. His grandfather was a blacksmith. Nearly twenty years of work. Call (484) 919-4548. Custom wrought iron with a French twist. Eric Zandotti, master blacksmith, Chester County studio near the Brandywine River. Call (484) 919-4548.

offerings.heading: Steel, fire, <mark>and a French hand.</mark>
items: Custom wrought iron furniture and architectural pieces, drawn in the classical French style.
A Chester County studio near the Brandywine River, where you can see the work before you commission it.
Nearly twenty years of making, with a grandfather who was a traditional blacksmith in Southern France.
Chester County studio near the Brandywine River

story.heading: Wrought iron is in Eric's blood
paragraphs: Eric Zandotti started Metalmorphose to bring steel to life in the classical French style. His grandfather was a traditional blacksmith in Southern France. The talent runs from that bench to this one.
Come to the Chester County studio near the Brandywine River. Call (484) 919-4548 and talk about the piece before anyone lights the forge.
Call (484) 919-4548. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.

experience.heading: How a commission should start.
items: Visit the studio. Wrought iron has to be seen, not picked from a thumbnail.
Eric will tell you what the French twist can do for the piece you actually want.
The work leaves as furniture, rail, or gate. You live with the steel, not a sketch.

feature.heading: A French twist on American iron
feature.text: Classical European, whimsical, modern. The through-line is a blacksmith who still hammers the scroll himself, in a studio by the Brandywine. Custom wrought iron furniture and architectural pieces, drawn in the classical French style.

contact.heading: Come to the <mark>Brandywine studio.</mark>
contact.sub: Chester County, near the Brandywine River. Confirm the visit on the official site or by phone. Call (484) 919-4548. Confirm details on the official site before you drive.
